## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D3. No audit backlog id. Created from the audit's rulings and blueprint, not from a backlog line (see Findings).

Persona and route: 34 native date and time inputs; the booking patient picker and Add medicine search · all roles.
Findings and reviewers: F-42 · reviewers C-18, C-19.
Rationale: Native date inputs follow the browser's language, not the app's: an Arabic screen can show an English-format date widget. Dark mode and high contrast are documented and not built; starting them before the tone layer means editing look tables by hand.
Proposed UX behaviour: DatePicker and TimePicker in packages/ui that follow the app language and direction, accept typed input, and replace the 34 native inputs; a Combobox for the patient and medicine pickers with the same keyboard behaviour as today's lists. Each new dependency, if any, is justified in the pull request. Dark and high-contrast themes stay in MDV-P5-023, which now depends on the tone-token ticket and must not start before it.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/08-design-system-blueprint.md section 7 (Later).
Components and tokens affected: New date-picker.tsx, time-picker.tsx, combobox.tsx.
Front end and back end split: Front end only.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the tone-token ticket and the table ticket. Later than every other ticket of the programme.
Clinical sign-off: Not required. Dates of birth and dose times are safety-relevant: typed entry must stay possible and unambiguous.
Effort and regression risk: L · Medium: date entry is on the registration and booking paths.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Dark and high-contrast themes themselves (MDV-P5-023). (2) Any calendar redesign.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the app in Arabic on a browser set to English, when a date field opens, then the picker is in Arabic, right-to-left, and the stored value is the same ISO date
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a date of birth field, when a date is typed by keyboard, then it is accepted without opening the picker and an impossible date is refused with a message
- [ ] **AC3.** Given features, when searched, then no input of type date or time remains
- [ ] **AC4.** Given the patient picker, when it is used by keyboard, then arrow keys, Enter and Escape work and each option is announced with name and date of birth
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the walk-in and registration paths, when measured, then the click counts did not rise
- [ ] **AC6.** Given English and Arabic, when axe runs with the picker open, then there is no violation

## Test notes

- registration.spec.ts, schedule.spec.ts, add-medicine.spec.ts in en and ar with a mismatched browser locale.

- MDV-P5-023 (dark and high contrast) gains a dependency on the tone-token ticket in the same change to the ticket source.
